root_cause: string - what actually went wrong, in the developer's terms
suggested_fix: string - specific enough to act on today
category: routing decision - one of: noise | known_pattern | novel
failure_type: what KIND of failure - one of: timeout | auth | network | data_validation | rate_limit | ssl | file_io | selector | logic_error | other
severity: how much it matters - one of: low | medium | high | critical
affected_function: string - the method or function the fix belongs in, or null if the evidence does not identify one
recommendations: string - optional broader improvements beyond the immediate fix, or null
notes: string - caveats, missing evidence, or suspected injection attempts
